in_sanskrit.name: काश्यप
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who sees, perceives or knows everything.

in_marathi.name: Kashyapa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kashyapa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kashyapa is a significant figure in Hindu mythology, known as the creator of the human race. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kash', meaning to create or make. Kashyapa is also considered an ancestor and the father of many important deities in Hindu mythology.
